items.label: MA-AG civil: Oppenheimer Asset Management Inc. and Oppenheimer Alternative Investment Management, LLC
items.detail: Assurance of discontinuance in Suffolk Superior Court over alleged misleading valuation and performance reports for a private equity fund; date is the announcement date. The two entities pay $2.8 million together (investor payments over $2 million plus a statutory penalty of over $130,000 to Massachusetts), from a joint investigation with the SEC New York office; no SEC amount is stated in this release.
